policies.privacyIntro: Paithan Municipal Council ("we", "us", "our") operates this digital portal to provide civic services, grievance redressal, and information to citizens, pilgrims, and visitors. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your personal data in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) and other applicable laws of India.
policies.privacyDataGrievance: Grievance submission data: name, phone number, email (optional), ward, sector, description, and optional photo.
policies.privacyDataFeedback: Feedback form data: name, email, phone, message.
policies.privacyDataAnalytics: Anonymous usage analytics: pages visited, time spent, device/browser type (via cookies).
policies.privacyDataCookies: Technical cookies for session management, language preference, and accessibility settings.
policies.privacyPurposeGrievance: To register, process, and update you on your grievance status.
policies.privacyPurposeFeedback: To respond to your feedback and improve our services.
policies.privacyPurposeLegal: To comply with legal obligations under the DPDP Act, RTI Act, and other applicable laws.
policies.privacyPurposeAnalytics: To understand portal usage and improve user experience (aggregated, anonymized).
policies.privacyLegalBasis: We process your personal data on the following lawful grounds under the DPDP Act:
policies.privacyLegalConsent: Consent (Section 6): For grievance submission and feedback, you explicitly provide consent.
policies.privacyLegalObligation: Legal obligation (Section 7): For maintaining records as required by municipal laws.
policies.privacyLegalLegitimate: Legitimate interest: For portal security, analytics, and service improvement.
policies.privacyRetention: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes stated:
policies.privacyRetentionGrievance: Grievance records: 7 years from resolution/rejection (as per municipal record retention rules).
policies.privacyRights: As a Data Principal, you have the following rights:
policies.privacyRightAccess: Right to access your personal data and obtain a copy.
policies.privacyRightCorrection: Right to correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
policies.privacyRightDeletion: Right to erasure (where processing is no longer necessary).
policies.privacyRightPortability: Right to data portability in a structured, commonly used format.
policies.privacyRightObjection: Right to object to processing (subject to legal obligations).
policies.privacyRightWithdraw: Right to withdraw consent (where consent is the basis).
policies.privacyGrievanceOfficer: You may contact our Data Protection Grievance Officer for any privacy concerns:
policies.privacyPlaceholderNotice: ⚠️ PLACEHOLDER — Replace with actual Grievance Officer details before going live:
policies.privacySecurity: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. This includes encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+), secure cloud hosting (Neon PostgreSQL), access controls, and regular security assessments.
policies.privacyChanges: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top reflects the latest revision. Material changes will be announced on the portal.
policies.privacyContact: For questions about this policy or your data, email munptn@gmail.com or call 02431-223010.
policies.termsIntro: Welcome to the Paithan Municipal Council Digital Portal. By accessing or using this portal, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the portal.
policies.termsAcceptance: Your use of the portal constitutes acceptance of these terms, which may be updated from time to time. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
policies.termsUsePersonal: Personal, non-commercial use to access civic information and services.
policies.termsUseProhibited: No unauthorized scraping, data mining, or automated access without written permission.
policies.termsUseCommercial: No commercial exploitation of portal content or services.
policies.termsUseAutomated: No bots, scripts, or automated tools that interfere with portal operation.
policies.termsIP: All content, design, and code on this portal (except user-submitted content) is the property of Paithan Municipal Council or its licensors, protected under Indian copyright law.
policies.termsDisclaimer: The portal is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including accuracy, completeness, or fitness for a particular purpose.
policies.termsLiability: Paithan Municipal Council shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use or inability to use the portal, to the fullest extent permitted by law.
policies.termsIndemnity: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless the Council from claims arising from your misuse of the portal or violation of these terms.
policies.termsGoverningLaw: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of courts at Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra.
policies.termsChanges: We reserve the right to modify these terms. Updated terms will be posted with a revised "Last updated" date.
policies.copyrightIntro: All content on this portal — text, images, graphics, logos, documents, and code — is owned by Paithan Municipal Council or used under license, and is protected by the Copyright Act, 1957 (India).
policies.copyrightOwnership: The Council retains all intellectual property rights in the portal content. "Paithan Municipal Council" name, logo, and seal are trademarks/service marks of the Council.
policies.copyrightPermittedPersonal: Personal, non-commercial viewing and printing for individual reference.
policies.copyrightPermittedEducational: Educational and research use with proper attribution.
policies.copyrightPermittedGovernment: Use by government departments for official purposes.
policies.copyrightRestrictCommercial: No commercial reproduction, distribution, or sale without written permission.
policies.copyrightRestrictModify: No modification, adaptation, or creation of derivative works.
policies.copyrightRestrictRedistribute: No systematic redistribution or mirroring of content.
policies.copyrightThirdParty: Some content (e.g., map embeds, third-party images) may be owned by others and used under license. Their respective copyright terms apply.
policies.copyrightInfringement: If you believe your copyrighted work has been used without authorization, contact munptn@gmail.com with details. We will investigate and act per the Copyright Act, 1957.
policies.copyrightContact: For permissions or inquiries, email munptn@gmail.com.
policies.hyperlinkingIntro: This policy governs hyperlinking to and from the Paithan Municipal Council Digital Portal.
policies.hyperlinkingPermitted: You may link to our homepage or any public page without prior permission.
policies.hyperlinkingNoFraming: Do not frame our pages or present our content as your own.
policies.hyperlinkingNoImpliedEndorsement: Do not imply endorsement by the Council without written permission.
policies.hyperlinkingNoMisleading: Do not use misleading link text or context.
policies.hyperlinkingFromUs: The portal contains links to external websites (e.g., Aaple Sarkar, e-District, government schemes).
policies.hyperlinkingExternalDisclaimer: We do not control external sites and are not responsible for their content, privacy practices, or availability.
policies.hyperlinkingNoControl: Inclusion of a link does not imply endorsement of the linked site.
policies.hyperlinkingNoResponsibility: We are not liable for any loss or damage from using external links.
policies.hyperlinkingRemoval: We reserve the right to request removal of any link to our portal. Contact munptn@gmail.com.
policies.disclaimerIntro: This portal is an informational and service delivery platform of Paithan Municipal Council. While we strive for accuracy, the information provided is for general guidance only.
policies.disclaimerGeneral: Content on this portal does not constitute legal, financial, medical, or professional advice. Consult qualified professionals for specific matters.
policies.disclaimerAccuracy: We make reasonable efforts to keep information current, but do not guarantee completeness, accuracy, or timeliness. Official records at the Council office prevail.
policies.disclaimerOfficial: This portal is a digital interface. Certified copies of records, certificates, and orders must be obtained from the Council office.
policies.disclaimerEmergency: This portal is NOT a substitute for emergency services. For emergencies, contact:
policies.disclaimerExternal: Links to external sites (Aaple Sarkar, e-District, etc.) are provided for convenience. We do not control or endorse them.
policies.disclaimerChatbot: The AI Citizen Assistant provides grounded responses from verified records. For Paithan-specific civic facts not in the knowledge base, it will state unavailability rather than guess. General knowledge answers are from the model's training. Not a replacement for official verification.
policies.accessibilityIntro: Paithan Municipal Council is committed to making this digital portal accessible to all citizens, including persons with disabilities, in line with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and GIGW 3.0 guidelines.
policies.accessibilityCompliance: This portal targets conformance with WCAG 2.1 Level AA. We continuously work to meet and exceed these standards.
policies.accessibilityFeatureKeyboard: Full keyboard navigation — all interactive elements reachable and operable via keyboard.
policies.accessibilityFeatureFocus: Visible focus indicators on all interactive elements (links, buttons, form fields).
policies.accessibilityFeatureSemantic: Semantic HTML5 structure with proper heading hierarchy, landmarks, and ARIA labels.
policies.accessibilityFeatureContrast: Color contrast ratios meeting WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text).
policies.accessibilityFeatureTextResize: Text resizing up to 200% without loss of content or functionality via Accessibility Toolbar.
policies.accessibilityFeatureSkipLink: Skip to main content link as the first focusable element on every page.
policies.accessibilityFeatureAltText: Meaningful alternative text for all informative images and non-text content.
policies.accessibilityFeatureForms: Accessible forms with labels, error identification, and instructions.
policies.accessibilityFeatureLanguage: Language of page and parts declared (en, mr, hi) for screen readers.
policies.accessibilityToolbar: An accessibility toolbar provides text size increase/decrease/reset, high-contrast toggle, and persists preferences via cookie.
policies.accessibilityKnownIssues: Some embedded content (e.g., map iframe, PDF attachments) may not fully meet WCAG AA. We are working to remediate.
policies.accessibilityTesting: We test with axe-core, Lighthouse, and manual keyboard/screen reader testing (NVDA, JAWS). New features undergo accessibility review before release.
policies.accessibilityFeedback: If you encounter accessibility barriers, please report them via the Contact page or email munptn@gmail.com.
